attacksRun.attack: the suffixed NT labels are invented identifiers (my own attack)
attacksRun.evidence: The sharpest available attack and the one I expected to charge. Live namedCorpusWhenFixturesExist.dr133 is the bare ['NT-1','NT-2','NT-6'], yet the artifact's stateNamed values read 'NT-1 unknown-Finding-frame', 'NT-2 extra-finding-member-on-closed-payload', 'NT-6 d9-exit-hosttermination-refused' — strings that are not the live list members. I searched live G21 v3 for them and they are there verbatim, as a single sentence in g21v3.basedOn.ntJoinV6.role: 'NT-1 unknown-Finding-frame, NT-2 extra-finding-member-on-closed-payload, NT-6 d9-exit-hosttermination-refused ride this gate. NT-3 and NT-5 do not.' Critically, the artifact keeps the two forms in the right places: classMemberVerbatim carries the BARE live id for all three, and the suffixed label appears only in stateNamed. So the live list is quoted exactly where it must be, and the descriptive label is quoted from elsewhere in the same pinned source. Nothing is coined.

It is not: both are keys of the LIVE G21 v3's basedOn, and the subject pins G21 v3 at a verified digest, so citing a nested field of the pinned source is a resolvable citation. I confirmed g21v3.basedOn.ntJoinV6.role and g21v3.basedOn.doctorV4.role both exist and both carry the quoted text ('FC-NC consented CA-1 process-tree containment is this gate, not G12.'). A naive read of this would have produced a false finding.

decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT. 19 attacks run, 18 refuted, 1 not sustained as a finding. 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. The 25 classMemberVerbatim values are ORDERED-EQUAL to live namedCorpusWhenFixturesExist liveCell + dr102 + dr133 + doctor (10+11+3+1), and the artifact's doesNotExecute equals live's ['NT-3','NT-5','NT-4','NT-7'] with none of the four appearing as a state. Two attacks I expected to sustain both failed on live bytes and are worth the coordinator's attention. First, the three NT states carry suffixed labels that are NOT the live list members — but that exact sentence is verbatim in g21v3.basedOn.ntJoinV6.role, and the artifact correctly keeps the bare live id in classMemberVerbatim while confining the label to stateNamed. Second, eight source fields cite 'ntJoinV6'/'doctorV4', which are not keys of this artifact's basedOn — they are keys of the LIVE G21 v3's basedOn, so the citations resolve against the pinned source. A third flag, bare FC-NC as an invented identifier, was my own too-narrow extraction; FC-NC occurs 5 times standalone in the live harness. Every CC state carries an inline 'does not reopen DR-102 SATISFIED' guard, which is the right discipline for naming an already-SATISFIED row's corpus. D9, exit number, and HostTermination appear only in negations or in a verbatim quote of live EV-6's refusal rule; only bare integers are 1, 4, and 26. No CC-12+, no invented NT or FC. G21 v3 has neither namedCorpusNotAuthored nor leftoverNameNote and the subject claims neither. All cited digests clean; HEAD 5d5d778; required-now 26. One observation: live properties are unevenly carried across the CC states.
